title: Nanoporous silica · overlapping Si/O atoms · preparation
parts: One connected nanoporous Si/O sphere candidate: 72,500 atoms, full core retained
material: Blue Bambu PLA Basic primary; Bambu PVA support body and interface secondary. Live mapping to be rechecked after relocation.

source.evidence: Source atomic coordinates: camilla.data SHA256 69e8be921c019d3a860cbf05067aab95129832255816b00fe27282c99de3ba9e. Type identities Si/O/H are inferred from coordination and distances; source provides no element names, bond topology or molecule labels. Selection retains every Si and O within 2.0 Å of any Si using the periodic cell, and removes all H and other O. The H-free selected coordinates SHA256 is 5145761db4e8b85c4e8ad76757913dd47a3448c73c3abc7b2e9c7bfce3e48a97.

notes: The100mm full native slice completed successfully and passed material-role, checksum and deposited-bounds audits. Actual slicer estimates are113.09gPLA,603.60gPVA and4d13h26m10s; this version is rejected for the material budget and deadline and was never uploaded or started. Six diagnostic coupon slices compared support styles and interfaces. At0.20mm, contour-following snug supports with one interface layer each side and a dense top contact used2.65g main support PVA versus7.05g for grid supports in those coupons; this is not a full-print forecast. A verified80mm full-core derivative is undergoing a new full native evaluation with that support profile. All72,500 selected main-component atoms and the original radius ratio remain;882 boundary-fragment exclusions are recorded and the full73,382-atom visualization is preserved. The live PVA estimate was49% of a500g roll (245g using official client calculation); a20% reserve gives196g planning allowance. This is telemetry, not weighed material. The user plans to relocate the printer, so automatic start is held until relocation readiness and fresh device, camera, mapping and exact-file checks. The target of17:00 Europe/Oslo onOctober26 remains unproven. No physical strength, print success, material dryness or PVA-removal claim.
